title: What Is Shilajit? The Complete Guide to the Himalayan Mineral Resin
description: What Shilajit is, where it comes from, its key benefits, and how to use pure Himalayan Shilajit resin safely. A clear, evidence-first guide from Salxir.
bodyHtml:
Shilajit is a sticky, tar-like resin that seeps from rocks high in the Himalayas and other mountain ranges. Formed over centuries from slowly decomposed plant matter, it has been used in Ayurvedic practice for more than 3,000 years. Today, pure Himalayan Shilajit is valued for its dense mix of minerals and fulvic acid. You can explore our full range of lab-tested Shilajit in resin, capsule, tablet, and honey-stick formats.

Where does Shilajit come from?

Genuine Shilajit is collected at high altitude, then purified and lab-tested to remove impurities and heavy metals. Quality varies enormously between sources, which is why third-party lab testing and transparent sourcing matter more than marketing claims.

Key benefits people look for

  • Energy and everyday vitality: many people take Shilajit to support steady energy rather than a caffeine-style spike.
  • Trace minerals: Shilajit naturally contains a broad range of trace minerals alongside fulvic and humic acids.
  • Recovery support: it is a popular addition to a daily wellness routine for active people.

How to take Shilajit resin

A typical serving is a pea-sized amount (roughly 300-500 mg) dissolved in warm water, tea, or milk once a day. Start small, be consistent, and give it a few weeks. Choose a lab-tested product and store it away from heat and direct sunlight.

What to look for when buying

Look for clear lab certificates, an honest origin story, and reasonable pricing. Be cautious of products that promise dramatic results or hide their testing. At Salxir, every batch is lab-tested and shipped from Finland.
